methodology.full: Three alternating fresh-process pairs per mode and host; parsing+analysis+execution included, process startup excluded. RSS is whole-process high-water mark.
methodology.controls: same-source: new Rank source on frozen/current runtime; compat-source: old Rank source on frozen/current runtime. One pair each, indicative only.
methodology.intelBackground: Scheduled ZFS scrub; explicit RANK466_ALLOW_IO_WAIT=true permits idle+IOwait >=95%, no swap I/O before each sample. Foreign CPU/Node jobs monitored and rejected. Not a wholly idle-host benchmark.
methodology.micro: LCM: 100000 cells, two warmups/five timed calls, independent checksum. Radix: three rotating rounds/size/variant, validated stable JS BigInt order. No macro sort speedup claim.

verification.mac: 396 checks in 19 files; filtered differential main+fixture 2 passed; source/test TypeScript; semantic/application/exclusion checks.
verification.intel: 396 checks in 19 files; exact filtered differential 2 selected cases passed (main and imported fixture).
verification.audits: No exhaustive audit or full npm test.
